heading: About Me
bio: I'm a software engineer who builds LLM systems that hold up in production. At Knowledge Agents I architect the agent-orchestration core: LangGraph and MCP pipelines that answer support questions with cited sources in 80+ languages. I also built the provider-agnostic RAG layer that lets the product swap between Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Azure with a single config change. Before that I co-founded Haven, a privacy app built in Flutter on Firebase and GCP. Haven placed Top 3 of 150+ teams at NYU Stern's 2025 Entrepreneur Challenge and was featured in Entrepreneur Magazine. Earlier I built backend services for Outlook India's news platform at Enpointe IO and a generative-AI sales assistant at Wolters Kluwer. I hold an MS in Computer Engineering from NYU and a B.Tech in Computer Science from Symbiosis International University.
philosophy: Python / TypeScript / Go / LangGraph / Ship, measure, repeat
